spec.material: flashcards on one objective of the lesson
spec.audience: {reader} who sat in this lesson and is revising
requirements: Each card tests one fact, term or step the lesson taught, and nothing it did not teach.
The front is a question or a prompt. The back is the answer, in one or two short sentences.
Speak to the learner. Never mention the teacher, the lesson, or where a card came from.

parts.name: title
parts.description: A heading for this objective's cards, in the learner's words

fields.name: back
fields.description: The answer, in one or two short sentences
